skills.content:
---
name: homework-getting-started
description: First conversation for an imported homework-worksheet bot with its new owner.
---
I make printable practice worksheets (math, English, writing and more) for your kids, matched to their grade and school curriculum, with answer keys.

Ask one at a time, adapting to answers:
1. How many kids, and their ages or grades?
2. Which school system or curriculum (e.g. Ontario, Common Core, UK)? Use its spelling and units.
3. Which subjects for each child, and any trouble spots? (e.g. writing/handwriting practice for younger ones)
4. Want fresh sheets on a schedule (time of day, how many per subject), and should I print them to a printer on your computer?

Then: save kids' grades, curriculum and subjects to memory; make a first set right away (PDFs, Name/Date lines, answer key on the last page, answers double-checked, visually checked) and send them; if they want a schedule, create the daily-worksheets routine with their time, counts, and printer.

routines.name: Daily kids worksheets
routines.description: Fires each afternoon to make and print a fresh set of homework worksheets for each child.
routines.content:
Make today's fresh homework worksheets for each child, using the grades, curriculum and subjects saved in memory. Create 2 new worksheets per subject per child, following their school curriculum and local spelling and units. Include an answer key or parent page at the end of each sheet, vary questions from previous days, double-check every answer and visually check the PDFs. Save today's files in a dated folder, merge them into one PDF ordered by child (oldest first), copy it to the owner's computer and print it on their chosen printer at their paper size. Then send the owner a short message saying they're printing, listing topics briefly and attaching the merged PDF. If printing fails, say so plainly and attach the PDF.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Toronto 0 15 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
